verified_facts.text: The Merrion is a restoration of four Georgian townhouses.
verified_facts.excerpt: An impeccable restoration of four Georgian townhouses

verified_facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Georgian Dublin, opposite Government Buildings.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a few minutes' walk from galleries, museums, the Dublin Convention Centre and the shops of Grafton Street.

verified_facts.text: The Drawing Rooms have open log fires and serve Afternoon Tea year-round.

verified_facts.text: During spring and summer, guests can enjoy the Garden Terrace.

verified_facts.text: The interiors were designed by Alice Roden, a local designer and weaver, using Irish fabrics and antiques.
verified_facts.excerpt: The interiors were designed by Alice Roden, a local designer and weaver who had never worked on a hotel before.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's two formal gardens were created by landscape designer Jim Reynolds to evoke an 18th-century estate.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel’s two formal gardens—one decorative, the other functional—were created by landscape designer Jim Reynolds to evoke the layout and plantings of an 18th-century estate.

verified_facts.text: The Merrion houses one of Ireland's most significant private collections of contemporary art, displayed in its public spaces.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Merrion houses one of Ireland’s most significant private collections of contemporary art, on quiet display throughout the hotel’s public spaces.
